units.source_text: 但是，也有这种情况：孩子到了四五岁，就让他学缫丝。

en.t: However, there were also cases like this: when children reached four or five years old, they were made to learn silk reeling.

units.source_text: 到了十一二岁，开始练习操作机子，然后就可以承揽外租机的活计。

en.t: By the time they were eleven or twelve, they began practicing how to operate the machines, and then they could take on work using rented-out machines.

units.source_text: 因此有许多孩子可以帮助家庭繁荣家业。

en.t: Because of this, many children were able to help their families and make the family business prosper.

units.source_text: 另外，六七十岁的老太婆也可以在自己家里帮忙缫丝，所以也有的人家是祖母和孙女俩对坐着干活的。

en.t: In addition, elderly women in their sixties or seventies could also help reel silk at home, so in some households a grandmother and granddaughter would sit facing each other as they worked.
